verses.english: Linked Discourses 14.16
Chapter Two
With Verses
At Sāvatthī.
“Mendicants, sentient beings join together and converge because of an element.
Those who have inferior convictions join together and converge with those who have inferior convictions.

verses.pali: Atītampi kho, bhikkhave, addhānaṁ dhātusova sattā saṁsandiṁsu samiṁsu.
verses.english: In the past …

verses.pali: Anāgatampi kho, bhikkhave, addhānaṁ dhātusova sattā saṁsandissanti samessanti.
verses.english: In the future …

verses.pali: Etarahipi kho, bhikkhave, paccuppannaṁ addhānaṁ dhātusova sattā saṁsandanti samenti.
verses.english: At present, too, sentient beings join together and converge because of an element.
Those who have inferior convictions join together and converge with those who have inferior convictions.

verses.pali: Seyyathāpi, bhikkhave, gūtho gūthena saṁsandati sameti;
verses.english: It’s like how dung joins together with dung,
urine with urine,
spit with spit,
pus with pus,
and blood with blood.

verses.pali: evameva kho, bhikkhave, dhātusova sattā saṁsandanti samenti.
verses.english: In the same way, sentient beings join together and converge because of an element.
Those who have inferior convictions join together and converge with those who have inferior convictions.
In the past …
In the future …

verses.pali: etarahipi kho paccuppannaṁ addhānaṁ dhātusova sattā saṁsandanti samenti.
verses.english: At present, too, sentient beings join together and converge because of an element.
Those who have inferior convictions join together and converge with those who have inferior convictions.
Sentient beings join together and converge because of an element.
Those who have good convictions join together and converge with those who have good convictions.

verses.pali: Atītampi kho, bhikkhave, addhānaṁ dhātusova sattā saṁsandiṁsu samiṁsu.
verses.english: In the past …
In the future …

verses.pali: etarahipi kho, bhikkhave, paccuppannaṁ addhānaṁ dhātusova sattā saṁsandanti samenti.
verses.english: At present, too, sentient beings join together and converge because of an element.
Those who have good convictions join together and converge with those who have good convictions.

verses.pali: Seyyathāpi, bhikkhave, khīraṁ khīrena saṁsandati sameti;
verses.english: It’s like how milk joins together with milk,
oil with oil,
ghee with ghee,
honey with honey,
and molasses with molasses.

verses.pali: evameva kho, bhikkhave, dhātusova sattā saṁsandanti samenti.
verses.english: In the same way, sentient beings join together and converge because of an element.
Those who have good convictions join together and converge with those who have good convictions.
In the past …
In the future …

verses.pali: etarahipi kho paccuppannaṁ addhānaṁ dhātusova sattā saṁsandanti samenti.
verses.english: At present, too, sentient beings join together and converge because of an element.
Those who have good convictions join together and converge with those who have good convictions.”
That is what the Buddha said.

verses.pali: Idaṁ vatvāna sugato athāparaṁ etadavoca satthā:
verses.english: Then the Holy One, the Teacher, went on to say:
“Socializing creates a snarl;
they’re cut off by being aloof.
If you’re lost in the middle of a great sea,
and you clamber up on a little log, you’ll sink.
So too, a person who lives well
sinks by relying on a lazy person.
Hence you should avoid such
a lazy person who lacks energy.
Dwell with the noble ones
who are secluded and determined
and always energetic;
the astute who practice absorption.”
